item.title: Tumbler Ridge students won’t ‘return to current school site’ after mass shooting
item.description: Tumbler Ridge students won’t be returning to their high school after last week’s mass shooting that killed eight victims, the local school district says.

item.title: Inuit look to Greenland’s social model as Canada pursues military buildup in Arctic
item.description: Inuit leaders say Canada can learn from Greenland’s approach to health, housing and social services as Ottawa weighs greater investment in northern infrastructure.

item.title: Canada’s Homan sounds off after rock is pulled
item.description: Canadian women's curling skip Rachel Homan sounded off Saturday after she had a rock pulled in an 8-7 loss to Switzerland, claiming she was unfairly punished for a 'double-touching' controversy involving Canada and Sweden in the men's draw.
